title: Budgets now support daily thresholds in addition to monthly thresholds
body: Budgets scoped to Unity Gateway, including budgets for Genie, now support daily per-user thresholds in addition to monthly per-user thresholds. You can set a daily threshold, a monthly threshold, or both, and configure separate alert, webhook, and block usage actions for each period. Daily thresholds reset at 00:00 UTC. See [Create and monitor budgets](/aws/en/admin/account-settings/budgets).
